title_en: PS5 Update Lets You Turn on Display Names, Adds Trending Now and Top 10 Views, and More
summary_en: Sony has released a fresh system software update for the PS5 that makes a number of interesting changes. Check out the version 26.06-14.00.00 patch notes.
body_en:
Sony has released a fresh system software update for the PlayStation 5 that makes a number of interesting changes.
Version 26.06-14.00.00 turns on Enhance PSSR Image Quality as a default setting. The PS5 Pro-exclusive feature is used even for games that support the previous version of PSSR, “so you can enjoy a sharper and clearer visual experience,” Sony said in a post on its website . You can turn it off if you want.
Elsewhere, you can now see who’s speaking while you’re in a voice chat by turning on Display Names, (details on how to enable this are in the patch notes, below). You can even choose where the speaker indicator appears on your screen.
Here’s an interesting one: the update lets you see Trending Now and Top 10 via the Community Activity widget in your Welcome Hub. Trending Now displays 10 multiplayer games or modes that are “surging in popularity,” Sony said. It sounds like the intention here is to surface new game releases or games with big updates.
Top 10, meanwhile, displays the 10 most popular games in the last week for your country or region. This isn’t information Sony usually provides publicly, so it will be interesting to see what ends up on the list. We don’t know how the list is determined, however. Is it total number of players during the period? Is it by peak concurrents? Play time? “Look here to see what games have a large community of players you can join,” Sony said.
PS5 System Software update Version 26.06-14.00.00 patch notes:
And, not wanting to be left out, the PS4 also has a system software update today, although don’t expect revelations from the patch notes . Version 14.00 improves “system software performance and stability.” Sony, you really do spoil us with these patch notes.
The PS5 update arrives alongside the release of the latest big exclusive from Sony: Marvel’s Wolverine.
